parameters.input_data_note: Declared path /app/assets/healthcare_hiring_900.csv was absent; used the uploaded asset /app/assets/6102412d.00.csv (900 rows, matches expected schema) per the fallback instruction in Step 1.

stages.name: data_loading
stages.message: 900 rows loaded; 0 rows dropped (role_applied and hired fully populated); no missing demographic data found; age_bracket derived; Yes/No fields coerced to boolean

stages.name: aggregation
stages.message: 125 rows written to disparity_metrics.csv (6 roles + ALL_ROLES rollup, x 5 dimensions, one row per group)

stages.name: programmatic_validation
stages.message: All 10 calculation checks passed on second attempt; first attempt caught a floating-point rounding edge case (ratio exactly 0.8 computed as 0.7999999999999999) which was fixed by rounding the ratio before threshold comparison, then re-validated

stages.name: report_generation
stages.message: compliance_report.md generated covering methodology, per-role findings, per-dimension rollup findings, full 57-row flagged table, recommendations, and caveats

stages.name: rubric_evaluation
stages.message: Rubric score: 5.0/5 on first evaluation; independent re-derivation of true_flagged_count (57), true top-5 by severity, and spot-checked ratios/p-values for all 5 dimensions matched the report exactly with zero discrepancies

stages.name: summary_accuracy_validation
stages.message: summary.md flagged-count (57) and top-5 findings verified programmatically against disparity_metrics.csv on round 1; exact match, no rewrite needed

statistical_rigor.notes: Fisher's exact and chi-square (Yates-corrected) tests both computed for every cell with candidate_count and reference_group count >= 30 (31 of 125 rows); statistically_significant verified programmatically to equal fisher_significant AND chi2_significant for all rows; low_confidence correctly marks 94/125 rows as directional-only; only 1 row is both non-low-confidence and statistically significant (Registered Nurse / age_bracket / 30-39).

completeness_of_breakdowns.notes: All 6 job roles individually addressed in Section 2; all 5 protected attributes addressed both per-role and in the ALL_ROLES rollup (Section 3); no role or dimension omitted or given only cursory treatment.

clarity_of_findings.notes: Full 57-row flagged table included with exact selection rates, four-fifths ratios, and both p-values inline; the single significant finding is called out with both p-values (0.0176 Fisher / 0.0207 chi-square) rather than requiring the reader to cross-reference the CSV.

actionability_of_recommendations.notes: 5 recommendations each reference a specific role/group/metric (e.g., RN age_bracket 30-39 ratio 0.47; Native American reference group n=24) and explicitly distinguish 'investigate further' from 'collect more data' from 'monitor, no action needed'.

appropriate_caveats_and_tone.notes: Dedicated Caveats section (Section 6) states correlation does not establish discriminatory intent, flags that 75.2% of rows are low-confidence, and explains the reference-group instability mechanism for race_ethnicity rather than asserting bias; report uses 'statistical disparity was observed' framing throughout, not definitive discrimination language.

factual_self_consistency.notes: Independent re-derivation from disparity_metrics.csv: true_flagged_count=57 matches report's stated '57 of 125 rows'; true top-5-by-severity (Medical Coder/Middle Eastern, Medical Coder/Multiracial, Registered Nurse/Multiracial, Clinic Administrator/Hispanic-Latino, Pharmacist/Black) matches the report's flagged-items table ordering exactly; spot-checked one ratio+p-value pair per dimension (gender: RN/Female 0.389; race_ethnicity: Clinic Admin/Hispanic-Latino 0.154; disability_status: Lab Tech/Yes 0.533; veteran_status: Medical Coder/No 0.636; age_bracket: RN/30-39 0.470, p=0.0176/0.0207) — all matched the CSV exactly with zero discrepancies found on the first drafted report.
